measurement: Installed macOS application; content-free internal instrumentation. Timer intervals do not by themselves prove a continuously blocked main thread.
extendedObservationNote: Settings, refresh and About succeeded. A subsequent quit-menu click returned cannotClickOffscreenElement; Cancel then Raise restored native focus and quit succeeded. This interval includes automation/menu tracking and is not a chat-rendering stall measurement.
limits: First AppKit probe layout is not physical screen presentation or frame rate.
Timer gaps include OS scheduling, rendering, menu tracking and AX observation overhead; they do not identify a single blocked function.
The scroll burst has no intermediate AX query; its window ends 100ms after the final delivered wheel event.
Six switch trials do not establish statistically significant acceleration.
AX action/confirmation durations and old unmatched wheel-boundary records are excluded from application-latency claims.
